editorial_notes: The Chinese source is the primary meaning reference; English speaker names and line structure are cross-checked.
CN #12 信息点 is nonspecific tactical information/clues; EN narrows it to a designated waypoint. RU uses 'зацепки' without inventing a waypoint.
CN #46 你……这是什么？ asks what the ability is; EN substitutes 'But... look at you...'. RU follows CN.
CN #50 leaves the accusation about watching fellow people unfinished; EN adds 'in cold blood' and 'Infected'. RU preserves the interrupted thought without adding the judgment.
CN #31 names Hoshiguma's shield 般若 (Hannya); RU uses 'Хання'.
CN/EN contain 55 matching numbered [name] dialogue lines in identical source line positions; no additional unnamed spoken text.
Commands, cinematics, sounds, delays, and assets are not stored in the RU dialogue map and are preserved by the existing preview builder.
CN and EN Git blobs differ; alignment does not prove identical meaning. Not an in-game-tested patch.
